name: like-button
title: Like button
description: A like button where the count is the point: it answers at once, rolls the number, plays one quiet ring and tells screen readers the exact count.
docs: Controlled: keep liked and count in state and update both in onToggle once the request has succeeded; the button already shows the new state while it waits, and rolls back with a message if onToggle rejects. defaultLiked leaves the state to the button, and count then stays as written for that starting state and moves with the button. Counts above 999 abbreviate by locale (1.2K, 1,2 Mio.) while the accessible name and the tooltip keep the exact number. Pass names to make the tooltip read "Liked by ...", and any @rhs-ui/icons glyph as icon: it is drawn filled once liked.
